response: There is no evidence to support the routine use of oral α-galactosidase to relieve irritable bowel symptoms. While some improvement in clinical response may be observed at a 4-week follow-up, this could be due to various factors, including non-responder drop out, and gastrointestinal side effects may occur as a result of α-galactosidase administration. Therefore, its use is not recommended as a standard treatment for irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) patients.
